mapper.insert: insert into biz_attachment (file_id, biz_type, biz_id, sort_no) values (#{fileId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{sortNo})

insert into file_object (bucket_name, object_key, url, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, uploader_id) values (#{bucketName}, #{objectKey}, #{url}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{uploaderId})
